label: copy phase: fed-back b, mid-copy of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, almost exclusively when the fed-back input is b (98.5% of activation mass; a few weak hits on input a). It never fires in the original or delimiter phase. Firing on b inputs depends strongly on position: it peaks when recall_idx is 3-4 (t about 11-13) in long sequences (L 8-9), and is rare early or late in the copy. The strongest activations are at L=9, step 12, where b is the 3rd original token being fed back, and are often followed by a (b->a bigram). Only about 8% of copy-phase b inputs activate it, and adding position terms raises precision only to about 0.3-0.4, so the gating is incompletely captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: b, a, -, j, c, h; least: p, z, e, d) and the token being output (most: a, b, q, y, 0, j; least: -, n, h, x); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, L=9 & t=12, L=9 & t=13.
